# Khaya Residences Bangsar (www.khaya-residence.my)

> Landing page for Khaya Residences (also marketed as Khaya Tree Residences), a 61-storey serviced residence on Jalan Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur, between Bangsar, Mid Valley and KL Sentral. Run by licensed real estate negotiator Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not the developer's website. Prices follow the developer's price list and can change.

## Project facts
- Name: Khaya Residences (Khaya Tree Residences / Khaya Tree Bangsar)
- Developer: Melati Ehsan Group; landowner: Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB)
- Location: Jalan Bangsar, 59200 Kuala Lumpur; about 400 m (6-minute walk) from Abdullah Hukum LRT & KTM station; 1 LRT stop from KL Sentral
- Property type: serviced residence with a retail podium (about 15,000 sq ft of retail); land title commercial under HDA
- Tenure: 99-year leasehold
- Land area: 3.88 acres; 1 tower, 61 storeys, 795 units
- Layouts: 12 types (A to L), built-up 630 to 1,321 sq ft
- Starting price: from RM 650,000 (developer price list)
- Estimated completion: Q2 2029
- Facilities (40+): 50 m infinity lap pool, rooftop gym, landscaped garden, wellness pavilion, sky social lounge, basketball court, pickleball court, kids club, retail podium
- Road access: Federal Highway, NPE, Jalan Bangsar, Sprint Expressway
- Nearby: KL Sentral, Mid Valley Megamall & The Gardens Mall, KL Eco City Mall, Bangsar Shopping Centre, Bangsar Village I & II, Pantai Hospital Kuala Lumpur
